review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this pending-decision case. The original PRD preserves REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, and DEC-001 consistently. DEC-001 materially affects omitted-option behavior and remains intentionally unresolved without human confirmation, so readiness must be blocked at decisions after repository and requirements evidence, without assignable tasks or assignment expectations. The conditional acceptance criteria do not authorize choosing OPT-1 or OPT-2. The supplied source owners support the message-formatting, normalization, readonly snapshot, inheritance, and fetch-filtering scope; forwarding and declaration consumers require inspection, not mandatory edits. Build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners, and the proposed test-d file is included by the existing compile-time verification configuration. Later reviewer and capability prerequisites do not invalidate the earlier deterministic decision block. Repository identity, base commit, paired-case reference, stable keys, and frozen release fingerprints are consistent across the supplied records. The distinct manifest and evaluation source digests and original versus persisted PRD digests have explicit provenance explaining their differences. I accept the Service's mechanical fingerprint bindings as supplied; I did not recompute digests or execute code. Reuse of the scoped project with retained historical operations is compatible with the stated isolation evidence, and no candidate outputs were used. Approval applies to this pending case and does not constitute a human Decision or approval of an unsupplied paired hypothetical case.
